title: Report to the Workplace Gender Equality Agency
what: Lodge a public report on gender equality indicators each year, once the business employs 100 or more people in Australia.

sources.title: Workplace Gender Equality Act 2012
sources.quote: A relevant employer must lodge with the Agency public reports in respect of each of the periods set out in this section unless subsection (3) applies to the employer in respect of a reporting period.

sources.title: Workplace Gender Equality Act 2012
sources.quote: • The Agency may review a relevant employer’s compliance with this Act by seeking further information from the employer.

administration.who: Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet
